title: How much money do I need to apply for a Pinnacle Blooms Network facility?
metaTitle: Franchise Application Requirements - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Understand the financial requirements for applicants interested in owning a Pinnacle Blooms Network facility, the leading network in specialized therapy services.
html: As part of our commitment to ensuring the success of each Pinnacle Blooms Network facility, we ask that each applicant possesses a minimum of 36% of the purchase price of a facility in cash without any obligations. It's important to note that having the financial resources is just one of many factors we consider, and doesn't guarantee approval of the application. We are looking for dedicated individuals who will passionately contribute to the Pinnacle Blooms mission, providing the best therapeutic services.
